differences.what: The message reveals that the agent actually reproduced the White-Bear Steering direction itself (the think/don't-think contrast) and compared its dose-response curve against Raman et al.'s reported peak as a calibration/sanity-check step before building the submitted method. The write-up only cites White-Bear Steering's reported finding as motivating context in its 'Where it came from' narrative; it never mentions that the agent rebuilt and ran the source's own vector or matched its dose curve.
